div.b: Why the authority sits on the fog

ul.li: if the cloud validates the ticket, migration fails whenever the WAN is down — exactly when local autonomy matters
the target knows the source fog node's public key (from the CA bundle), so it can validate locally
the PDP is still asked for the migrate decision beforehand; during a partition a fog PDP replica answers
